facts.text: Tim shared a quote by J.K. Rowling that he finds inspiring during tough times.

evidence.quote: Yeah! There's a quote by J.K. Rowling that I really like: 'Turn on the light - happiness hides in the darkest of times.' That's how I keep hope alive during tough times.

facts.text: John acknowledged the quote and expressed appreciation for its motivational value.

evidence.quote: Nice quote! It reminds us to stay positive and find joy even in hard times. It's a guiding light when things get rough. I appreciate you sharing it!

facts.text: John described writing motivational quotes and strategies on a whiteboard to help with staying focused during tough workouts.

evidence.quote: On that whiteboard, I wrote down some motivational quotes and strategies to help me stay focused and push through tough workouts. It really helps me stay motivated and keep improving.

facts.text: John mentioned keeping a plaque on his desk as a physical reminder to believe in himself and face obstacles.

evidence.quote: This plaque I keep on my desk is a constant reminder to believe in myself. It helps me trust my abilities and face any obstacles. Having physical reminders like this really helps me stay motivated.
